## About
Foreign Auto Hospital is an auto repair shop on Red Lion Rd, serving North East Philadelphia and Huntingdon Valley. We service all makes and models, but European and foreign cars are what we know best.
Dmitry and his crew handle maintenance and repair, from tune-ups and AC repair to brake service and computer diagnostics. One reviewer said we explained everything clearly and didn't try to push unnecessary repairs. That's how we like to work.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 101 reviews. If something feels off with your car, give us a call or bring it by and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Wheel alignment: One reviewer said their car drives straight and the steering feels smoother after an alignment. Another noted we use Hunter equipment.
- Brake service: Pads, rotors, calipers, hoses and the rest of the brake system. One reviewer said their brakes were even tighter after a visit.
- Computer diagnostics: We read what your car's computer is telling us, then find the problem and fix it.
- Check Engine Light: Light came on? Bring it in and we'll inspect it and tell you what's going on.
- AC repair: AC repair to keep you cool on hot Philadelphia days.
- Timing Belt Replacement: Timing belt work done right, so it doesn't turn into a bigger repair later.
- Pre-purchase Car Inspection: Thinking about buying a used car? Have us look it over first.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on foreign cars?
A: No. Foreign and European cars are our specialty, but we service all makes and models, and every type of car, truck and SUV.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes, on most jobs. Come in or call and we'll give you an estimate.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. Use the appointment form on our site to pick a time that works for you, or just give us a call.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
